content: If the Dem module is requested to clear diagnostic information and the selected DTC is set to DTC group `all DTCs' and the selected DTCOrigin is set to DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_MIRROR_MEMORY , the Dem shall clear only the event entries assigned to the mirror event memory. It does not affect UDS status.
